+## Rules and exact outcomes
+
+Expected points are the 13 five-minute instants 19:00 through 20:00 in `[19:00,20:05)`; coverage numerator is distinct qualifying probe timestamps, denominator 13 (general windows derive their own aligned count), capped at 1. Need `>=0.8`, with no inferred path across a >10-minute gap. Above upper or below lower policy needs two consecutive GOOD samples at least five minutes apart; return needs two consecutive values inside band by at least effective `cold-return-hysteresis`. Start bounds `[last in-band,first out-of-band]`, end bounds `[last out-of-band,first stable in-band]`; initially out of band means unknown earliest start. Open episode has `duration_bounds.high=null`. Low duration is max(0, earliest return - latest start), or window end - latest start for a continuously observed open episode; high is latest return - earliest start only when both known. `degree_minute_bounds` is the sum of adjacent observed rectangles over intervals <=10 minutes using min/max exceedance; no gap area. `peak_observed` is max observed sample. Exposure Finding requires 15-minute low duration, >=0.8 coverage and source gate; otherwise POSSIBLE/UNKNOWN. No spoilage, part-failure or continuous curve claim. Normal -> `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED`. Excursion -> first high at 19:15, open, duration low 45 min, high null. Backup-failed -> same exposure, door CONTEXT. Missing-probe -> 7/13, temperature UNKNOWN and no exposure Finding. Late-reading -> 12/13 at 20:05 and 13/13 at 20:10 with new basis/revision, old history retained.
+
+Start chain groups by `(correlation_id,generator_asset_id,outage episode)` and accepted event IDs. Required steps: POWER_LOSS, START_REQUEST, START_RESULT, generator state, TRANSFER_RESULT if sensor bound, bus state, compressor state, probe response. Within 30-second attested source-clock ordering tolerance, request 19:05 -> success 19:07 -> transfer 19:08 for normal. Explicit failed result 19:05 after 19:00 request supports `OBSERVED_FAILURE` only with no conflicting GOOD success. Timeout from Foundation = 5 min; inferred failure from timeout additionally requires complete generator state coverage through timeout. Missing transfer is `UNKNOWN_STEP` for transfer only; bus state cannot replace it. Contradictory GOOD success and failure for same correlation -> `CONTRADICTORY`, never failure. Equal event-ID conflict is a rejected S2 ordinal, not an accepted contradictory outcome. Excluded clock skew/SUSPECT/unbound records never support claims. Claim levels are `OBSERVED|BOUNDED|POSSIBLE|UNKNOWN|CONTRADICTORY`.
+
+Episode key is SHA-256 canonical JSON array `[tenant_id,site_id,kind,subject_asset_id,first_qualifying_event_or_crossing_evidence_id]` (UUIDs lowercase text), stored as `episode_key_sha256`. Stable anchor survives late evidence changing bounds. A newly supported different anchor after old invalidation creates a new episode and `split_from_episode_id`; old episode gets an immutable `NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED` revision and FindingRevision. Other transitions are `SUPPORT_CHANGED` when linked evidence changes and `BASIS_REFRESHED` when only effective configuration/source gate/known cutoff changes. Excursion and start response have separate Findings, can share public events, and later use one overlap group. Reuse `postgres_finding_store.py:_insert_finding,_insert_revision` with domain `cold_chain`; avoid dispatch-specific candidate-minute fields.

Default observations empty. `cold-observation/1` in `simulator/assetops_simulator/observation/transform.py` applies zero bias, half-even 0.1°C quantization and +3-second publication latency. DROP emits nothing. HOLD keeps original `source_time` and is released at 20:10. Probe failure emits one `UNAVAILABLE`/`SENSOR_FAILURE` point, then no numeric readings (unit test forcing only). No manual log is emitted or bound.

+## Inputs, model and selection

Only exact `cold-roles-1` effective row/asset/role, GOOD, calibrated primary chamber probe and attested clock is qualifying; SUSPECT, unbound, clock-skewed and contradictory records remain linked as CONTEXT/EXCLUDED with reason. Relevant cold `accepted_evidence` after intake enqueues a bracketed cold job; duplicate or rejected ordinal does not. A queued/failed newer job makes previous selected read `PENDING_RECOMPUTE` until the shared transaction commits.

+## Rules and exact outcomes
+
+Expected points are the 13 five-minute instants 19:00 through 20:00 in `[19:00,20:05)`; coverage numerator is distinct qualifying probe timestamps, denominator 13 (general windows derive their own aligned count), capped at 1. Need `>=0.8`, with no inferred path across a >10-minute gap. Above upper or below lower policy needs two consecutive GOOD samples at least five minutes apart; return needs two consecutive values inside band by at least effective `cold-return-hysteresis`. Start bounds `[last in-band,first out-of-band]`, end bounds `[last out-of-band,first stable in-band]`; initially out of band means unknown earliest start. Open episode has `duration_bounds.high=null`. Low duration is max(0, earliest return - latest start), or window end - latest start for a continuously observed open episode; high is latest return - earliest start only when both known. `degree_minute_bounds` is the sum of adjacent observed rectangles over intervals <=10 minutes using min/max exceedance; no gap area. `peak_observed` is max observed sample. Exposure Finding requires 15-minute low duration, >=0.8 coverage and source gate; otherwise POSSIBLE/UNKNOWN. No spoilage, part-failure or continuous curve claim. Normal -> `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED`. Excursion -> first high at 19:15, open, duration low 45 min, high null. Backup-failed -> same exposure, door CONTEXT. Missing-probe -> 7/13, temperature UNKNOWN and no exposure Finding. Late-reading -> 12/13 at 20:05 and 13/13 at 20:10 with new basis/revision, old history retained.
+
+Start chain groups by `(correlation_id,generator_asset_id,outage episode)` and accepted event IDs. Required steps: POWER_LOSS, START_REQUEST, START_RESULT, generator state, TRANSFER_RESULT if sensor bound, bus state, compressor state, probe response. Within 30-second attested source-clock ordering tolerance, request 19:05 -> success 19:07 -> transfer 19:08 for normal. Explicit failed result 19:05 after 19:00 request supports `OBSERVED_FAILURE` only with no conflicting GOOD success. Timeout from Foundation = 5 min; inferred failure from timeout additionally requires complete generator state coverage through timeout. Missing transfer is `UNKNOWN_STEP` for transfer only; bus state cannot replace it. Contradictory GOOD success and failure for same correlation -> `CONTRADICTORY`, never failure. Equal event-ID conflict is a rejected S2 ordinal, not an accepted contradictory outcome. Excluded clock skew/SUSPECT/unbound records never support claims. Claim levels are `OBSERVED|BOUNDED|POSSIBLE|UNKNOWN|CONTRADICTORY`.
+
+Episode key is SHA-256 canonical JSON array `[tenant_id,site_id,kind,subject_asset_id,first_qualifying_event_or_crossing_evidence_id]` (UUIDs lowercase text), stored as `episode_key_sha256`. Stable anchor survives late evidence changing bounds. A newly supported different anchor after old invalidation creates a new episode and `split_from_episode_id`; old episode gets an immutable `NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED` revision and FindingRevision. Other transitions are `SUPPORT_CHANGED` when linked evidence changes and `BASIS_REFRESHED` when only effective configuration/source gate/known cutoff changes. Excursion and start response have separate Findings, can share public events, and later use one overlap group. Reuse `postgres_finding_store.py:_insert_finding,_insert_revision` with domain `cold_chain`; avoid dispatch-specific candidate-minute fields.

Basis SHA is SHA-256 of canonical JSON with keys `analytic_id,model_version,tenant_id,site_id,window,known_at,foundation_revision_ids,binding_revision_ids,source_gate,records`; records sorted by `(evidence_id,envelope_sha256)` and include both fields. `source_gate` is the exact S4-05 classification plus source IDs, not a boolean.
+
+`assessment_worker.py:DispatchAssessmentWorker` is the orchestration pattern. Add `ColdAssessmentWorker` with `assess_explicit` and `run_once`, using `recompute_job.domain='cold_chain'`. `postgres_assessment_store.py` alone inserts `analytic_run`, `analytic_run_evidence`, `assessment_revision`, `cold_episode`, `cold_episode_revision`, `cold_episode_evidence`; `postgres_finding_store.py` alone inserts/reads `finding` and `finding_revision`. Refactor both adapters to accept one caller-owned SQLAlchemy `Connection`; worker starts one transaction, persists assessment, episode, Finding and completes the job in it. No partial projection on failure. Existing dispatch methods keep their old transactions and bytes. Duplicate basis returns the existing revision; changed basis appends a revision. Relevant cold `accepted_evidence` after intake enqueues a bracketed cold job; duplicate or rejected ordinal does not. A queued/failed newer job makes previous selected read `PENDING_RECOMPUTE` until the shared transaction commits.
+
+## Rules and exact outcomes
+
+Expected points are the 13 five-minute instants 19:00 through 20:00 in `[19:00,20:05)`; coverage numerator is distinct qualifying probe timestamps, denominator 13 (general windows derive their own aligned count), capped at 1. Need `>=0.8`, with no inferred path across a >10-minute gap. Above upper or below lower policy needs two consecutive GOOD samples at least five minutes apart; return needs two consecutive values inside band by at least effective `cold-return-hysteresis`. Start bounds `[last in-band,first out-of-band]`, end bounds `[last out-of-band,first stable in-band]`; initially out of band means unknown earliest start. Open episode has `duration_bounds.high=null`. Low duration is max(0, earliest return - latest start), or window end - latest start for a continuously observed open episode; high is latest return - earliest start only when both known. `degree_minute_bounds` is the sum of adjacent observed rectangles over intervals <=10 minutes using min/max exceedance; no gap area. `peak_observed` is max observed sample. Exposure Finding requires 15-minute low duration, >=0.8 coverage and source gate; otherwise POSSIBLE/UNKNOWN. No spoilage, part-failure or continuous curve claim. Normal -> `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED`. Excursion -> first high at 19:15, open, duration low 45 min, high null. Backup-failed -> same exposure, door CONTEXT. Missing-probe -> 7/13, temperature UNKNOWN and no exposure Finding. Late-reading -> 12/13 at 20:05 and 13/13 at 20:10 with new basis/revision, old history retained.
+
+Start chain groups by `(correlation_id,generator_asset_id,outage episode)` and accepted event IDs. Required steps: POWER_LOSS, START_REQUEST, START_RESULT, generator state, TRANSFER_RESULT if sensor bound, bus state, compressor state, probe response. Within 30-second attested source-clock ordering tolerance, request 19:05 -> success 19:07 -> transfer 19:08 for normal. Explicit failed result 19:05 after 19:00 request supports `OBSERVED_FAILURE` only with no conflicting GOOD success. Timeout from Foundation = 5 min; inferred failure from timeout additionally requires complete generator state coverage through timeout. Missing transfer is `UNKNOWN_STEP` for transfer only; bus state cannot replace it. Contradictory GOOD success and failure for same correlation -> `CONTRADICTORY`, never failure. Equal event-ID conflict is a rejected S2 ordinal, not an accepted contradictory outcome. Excluded clock skew/SUSPECT/unbound records never support claims. Claim levels are `OBSERVED|BOUNDED|POSSIBLE|UNKNOWN|CONTRADICTORY`.
+
+Episode key is SHA-256 canonical JSON array `[tenant_id,site_id,kind,subject_asset_id,first_qualifying_event_or_crossing_evidence_id]` (UUIDs lowercase text), stored as `episode_key_sha256`. Stable anchor survives late evidence changing bounds. A newly supported different anchor after old invalidation creates a new episode and `split_from_episode_id`; old episode gets an immutable `NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED` revision and FindingRevision. Other transitions are `SUPPORT_CHANGED` when linked evidence changes and `BASIS_REFRESHED` when only effective configuration/source gate/known cutoff changes. Excursion and start response have separate Findings, can share public events, and later use one overlap group. Reuse `postgres_finding_store.py:_insert_finding,_insert_revision` with domain `cold_chain`; avoid dispatch-specific candidate-minute fields.
+

 # W2-02 build stopped: Architect questions (Implementer, 2026-10-17)
 
+## Architect answers — `D-2026-10-17-w2-02-buildspec`
+
+The exact implementation instructions are `.agent/W2-02-build-spec.md` and `.agent/W2-03-build-spec.md`. These answers supersede the alternatives posed below.
+
+1. **New registered fixture.** Use `COLD-LAB-001`, with room/probe/generator/grid/bus/compressor codes and all thirteen exact §4 Foundation values in the W2-02 spec. `door-1` is a scenario forcing address linked to the room's door sensor. COLD-001/002 stay untouched. The pack consumes the effective frozen Foundation values; the six-case fixture requires the §4 values exactly. No default silently overrides a stored value.
+2. **New immutable v4 binding revision.** `BindingService.validate_bindings` supplies `v4_mapping` from the closed tuple table after validating role/unit. Publish a new revision at `2026-10-01T00:01:00Z`; no rewrite of W2-01 snapshots or their golden bytes. The scenario is later than this effective instant.
+3. **Gateway constructs v4.** Add a strict `DeviceReport` schema version 2 with the exact fields in the W2-02 spec. Activated binding metadata selects the v4 branch, and the gateway remains the sole sequence/message allocator. Stage displays the gateway's canonical v4 outbox bytes; host does not forge envelopes.
+4. **Separate strict document.** `cold-scenario/1` has its own parser and closed keys specified in the W2-02 spec. Forcing and observation fault rows both live in each scenario document; `cold-observation/1` is the versioned transform implementation. Add six catalog entries for the registered cold Lab Site, leaving legacy scenario parsing unchanged.
+5. **Run identity.** Optional `FrozenScenarioBinding.scenario_sha256` and optional `FrozenProfileBinding.observation_profile_id`, `observation_profile_version`, `observation_sha256`. Cold requires them. `runs/parsing.py` omits them entirely for old runs; old fingerprints and serialized bytes remain unchanged.
+6. **Replay is an explicit run read.** Require `run_id`, scope by authenticated tenant/Site/owner, join `evidence_publication` through `batch_publication_link` to batches, dispositions and accepted evidence, and read frozen profile/digest from the persisted run. Select all batches of that run in recorded order; report latest publication ID plus all IDs. Hash canonical ordered public disposition tuples as `public_digest`, defined in the W2-02 spec. Use 401/403 injection tests like the Foundation route and enforce an owner Lab role in production; `development_access` alone is insufficient as production authorization.
+7. **Yes.** `cold-publication/1` publishes one probe-failure `UNAVAILABLE`/`SENSOR_FAILURE` reading, followed by no numeric sample. A unit forcing tests it; none of the six scenarios forces physical probe failure.
+8. **Move and re-export.** Put `PhysicallyUnacceptable` in neutral `packs/errors.py`, re-export from `packs/fuel.py`; cold imports the neutral module. Existing imports keep working.
+9. **No manual log in W2-02.** The v4 tuple stays reserved, but COLD-LAB-001 declares no operator-log device/binding and the six scenarios emit none.

+# W2-03 code-anchored build spec
+
+Decision `D-2026-10-17-w2-02-buildspec`. Implements `tasks/W2-03-cold-assessment.md` on the registered W2-02 replay. Use only accepted v4 public evidence, effective configuration and clock/source attestation. The six W2-02 manifest cases are the required phase-1 input; do not hand-insert accepted rows.

+## Inputs, model and selection
+
+Add `backend/assetops_backend/analytics/cold.py` with frozen `ColdEvidence` (`evidence_id`, `envelope_sha256`, `family`, `record_kind`, `role`, `asset_id`, `source_time`, `received_at`, `decided_at`, `quality`, `value`, `unit`, `event_id`, `correlation_id`, `outcome`, `source_id`, `clock_attested`), `ColdWindow` (`from_at`,`to_at`,`known_at`), `ColdExcursion`, `ColdStartChain` and `ColdAssessment`. Add pure `assess_excursion` and `assess_start_response`; IDs `cold-excursion/1`, `cold-start-response/1`. `backend/assetops_backend/analytics/adapters/postgres_assessment_store.py:query_evidence,_configuration,_persist,enqueue` is the pattern: select `accepted_evidence` joined to `ingestion_batch`, time-effective `foundation_revision` and `binding_set_revision` via `basis_from_snapshot`, and S4-05 `batch_publication_link/evidence_publication` for provenance. Require `site_id`, `source_time >= from`, `< to`, `received_at <= known_at`, and ingestion `decided_at <= known_at`. Order `(source_time,received_at,id)`. Only exact `cold-roles-1` effective row/asset/role, GOOD, calibrated primary chamber probe and attested clock is qualifying; SUSPECT, unbound, clock-skewed and contradictory records remain linked as CONTEXT/EXCLUDED with reason. Do not choose a latest publication by display name. Select the effective Foundation and binding at each evidence source time, and refuse if multiple periods overlap. `known_at` defaults to latest committed disposition watermark at request start; never a simulated clock. Basis SHA is SHA-256 of canonical JSON with keys `analytic_id,model_version,tenant_id,site_id,window,known_at,foundation_revision_ids,binding_revision_ids,source_gate,records`; records sorted by `(evidence_id,envelope_sha256)` and include both fields. `source_gate` is the exact S4-05 classification plus source IDs, not a boolean.
+
+`assessment_worker.py:DispatchAssessmentWorker` is the orchestration pattern. Add `ColdAssessmentWorker` with `assess_explicit` and `run_once`, using `recompute_job.domain='cold_chain'`. `postgres_assessment_store.py` alone inserts `analytic_run`, `analytic_run_evidence`, `assessment_revision`, `cold_episode`, `cold_episode_revision`, `cold_episode_evidence`; `postgres_finding_store.py` alone inserts/reads `finding` and `finding_revision`. Refactor both adapters to accept one caller-owned SQLAlchemy `Connection`; worker starts one transaction, persists assessment, episode, Finding and completes the job in it. No partial projection on failure. Existing dispatch methods keep their old transactions and bytes. Duplicate basis returns the existing revision; changed basis appends a revision. Relevant cold `accepted_evidence` after intake enqueues a bracketed cold job; duplicate or rejected ordinal does not. A queued/failed newer job makes previous selected read `PENDING_RECOMPUTE` until the shared transaction commits.
+
+## Rules and exact outcomes
+
+Expected points are the 13 five-minute instants 19:00 through 20:00 in `[19:00,20:05)`; coverage numerator is distinct qualifying probe timestamps, denominator 13 (general windows derive their own aligned count), capped at 1. Need `>=0.8`, with no inferred path across a >10-minute gap. Above upper or below lower policy needs two consecutive GOOD samples at least five minutes apart; return needs two consecutive values inside band by at least effective `cold-return-hysteresis`. Start bounds `[last in-band,first out-of-band]`, end bounds `[last out-of-band,first stable in-band]`; initially out of band means unknown earliest start. Open episode has `duration_bounds.high=null`. Low duration is max(0, earliest return - latest start), or window end - latest start for a continuously observed open episode; high is latest return - earliest start only when both known. `degree_minute_bounds` is the sum of adjacent observed rectangles over intervals <=10 minutes using min/max exceedance; no gap area. `peak_observed` is max observed sample. Exposure Finding requires 15-minute low duration, >=0.8 coverage and source gate; otherwise POSSIBLE/UNKNOWN. No spoilage, part-failure or continuous curve claim. Normal -> `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED`. Excursion -> first high at 19:15, open, duration low 45 min, high null. Backup-failed -> same exposure, door CONTEXT. Missing-probe -> 7/13, temperature UNKNOWN and no exposure Finding. Late-reading -> 12/13 at 20:05 and 13/13 at 20:10 with new basis/revision, old history retained.
+
+Start chain groups by `(correlation_id,generator_asset_id,outage episode)` and accepted event IDs. Required steps: POWER_LOSS, START_REQUEST, START_RESULT, generator state, TRANSFER_RESULT if sensor bound, bus state, compressor state, probe response. Within 30-second attested source-clock ordering tolerance, request 19:05 -> success 19:07 -> transfer 19:08 for normal. Explicit failed result 19:05 after 19:00 request supports `OBSERVED_FAILURE` only with no conflicting GOOD success. Timeout from Foundation = 5 min; inferred failure from timeout additionally requires complete generator state coverage through timeout. Missing transfer is `UNKNOWN_STEP` for transfer only; bus state cannot replace it. Contradictory GOOD success and failure for same correlation -> `CONTRADICTORY`, never failure. Equal event-ID conflict is a rejected S2 ordinal, not an accepted contradictory outcome. Excluded clock skew/SUSPECT/unbound records never support claims. Claim levels are `OBSERVED|BOUNDED|POSSIBLE|UNKNOWN|CONTRADICTORY`.
+
+Episode key is SHA-256 canonical JSON array `[tenant_id,site_id,kind,subject_asset_id,first_qualifying_event_or_crossing_evidence_id]` (UUIDs lowercase text), stored as `episode_key_sha256`. Stable anchor survives late evidence changing bounds. A newly supported different anchor after old invalidation creates a new episode and `split_from_episode_id`; old episode gets an immutable `NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED` revision and FindingRevision. Other transitions are `SUPPORT_CHANGED` when linked evidence changes and `BASIS_REFRESHED` when only effective configuration/source gate/known cutoff changes. Excursion and start response have separate Findings, can share public events, and later use one overlap group. Reuse `postgres_finding_store.py:_insert_finding,_insert_revision` with domain `cold_chain`; avoid dispatch-specific candidate-minute fields.
+

+The exact implementation instructions are `.agent/W2-02-build-spec.md` and `.agent/W2-03-build-spec.md`. These answers supersede the alternatives posed below.

+1. **New registered fixture.** Use `COLD-LAB-001`, with room/probe/generator/grid/bus/compressor codes and all thirteen exact §4 Foundation values in the W2-02 spec. `door-1` is a scenario forcing address linked to the room's door sensor. +2. **New immutable v4 binding revision.** `BindingService.validate_bindings` supplies `v4_mapping` from the closed tuple table after validating role/unit. Publish a new revision at `2026-10-01T00:01:00Z`; no rewrite of W2-01 snapshots or their golden bytes. The scenario is later than this effective instant.
+3. **Gateway constructs v4.** Add a strict `DeviceReport` schema version 2 with the exact fields in the W2-02 spec. Activated binding metadata selects the v4 branch, and the gateway remains the sole sequence/message allocator. Stage displays the gateway's canonical v4 outbox bytes; host does not forge envelopes.
+4. **Separate strict document.** `cold-scenario/1` has its own parser and closed keys specified in the W2-02 spec. +5. **Run identity.** Optional `FrozenScenarioBinding.scenario_sha256` and optional `FrozenProfileBinding.observation_profile_id`, `observation_profile_version`, `observation_sha256`. Cold requires them. `runs/parsing.py` omits them entirely for old runs; old fingerprints and serialized bytes remain unchanged.

Use 401/403 injection tests like the Foundation route and enforce an owner Lab role in production; `development_access` alone is insufficient as production authorization.
+7. **Yes.** `cold-publication/1` publishes one probe-failure `UNAVAILABLE`/`SENSOR_FAILURE` reading, followed by no numeric sample. A unit forcing tests it; none of the six scenarios forces physical probe failure.
+8. **Move and re-export.** Put `PhysicallyUnacceptable` in neutral `packs/errors.py`, re-export from `packs/fuel.py`; cold imports the neutral module. Existing imports keep working.
+9. **No manual log in W2-02.** The v4 tuple stays reserved, but COLD-LAB-001 declares no operator-log device/binding and the six scenarios emit none.

+# W2-03 code-anchored build spec
+
+Decision `D-2026-10-17-w2-02-buildspec`. Implements `tasks/W2-03-cold-assessment.md` on the registered W2-02 replay. Use only accepted v4 public evidence, effective configuration and clock/source attestation. The six W2-02 manifest cases are the required phase-1 input; do not hand-insert accepted rows.

+## Inputs, model and selection
+
+Add `backend/assetops_backend/analytics/cold.py` with frozen `ColdEvidence` (`evidence_id`, `envelope_sha256`, `family`, `record_kind`, `role`, `asset_id`, `source_time`, `received_at`, `decided_at`, `quality`, `value`, `unit`, `event_id`, `correlation_id`, `outcome`, `source_id`, `clock_attested`), `ColdWindow` (`from_at`,`to_at`,`known_at`), `ColdExcursion`, `ColdStartChain` and `ColdAssessment`. Require `site_id`, `source_time >= from`, `< to`, `received_at <= known_at`, and ingestion `decided_at <= known_at`. Order `(source_time,received_at,id)`. Only exact `cold-roles-1` effective row/asset/role, GOOD, calibrated primary chamber probe and attested clock is qualifying; SUSPECT, unbound, clock-skewed and contradictory records remain linked as CONTEXT/EXCLUDED with reason. Do not choose a latest publication by display name. Select the effective Foundation and binding at each evidence source time, and refuse if multiple periods overlap. `known_at` defaults to latest committed disposition watermark at request start; never a simulated clock. Basis SHA is SHA-256 of canonical JSON with keys `analytic_id,model_version,tenant_id,site_id,window,known_at,foundation_revision_ids,binding_revision_ids,source_gate,records`; records sorted by `(evidence_id,envelope_sha256)` and include both fields. `source_gate` is the exact S4-05 classification plus source IDs, not a boolean.

+`assessment_worker.py:DispatchAssessmentWorker` is the orchestration pattern. Refactor both adapters to accept one caller-owned SQLAlchemy `Connection`; worker starts one transaction, persists assessment, episode, Finding and completes the job in it. No partial projection on failure. Existing dispatch methods keep their old transactions and bytes. Duplicate basis returns the existing revision; changed basis appends a revision. Relevant cold `accepted_evidence` after intake enqueues a bracketed cold job; duplicate or rejected ordinal does not. A queued/failed newer job makes previous selected read `PENDING_RECOMPUTE` until the shared transaction commits.
+
+## Rules and exact outcomes
+
+Expected points are the 13 five-minute instants 19:00 through 20:00 in `[19:00,20:05)`; coverage numerator is distinct qualifying probe timestamps, denominator 13 (general windows derive their own aligned count), capped at 1. Need `>=0.8`, with no inferred path across a >10-minute gap. Above upper or below lower policy needs two consecutive GOOD samples at least five minutes apart; return needs two consecutive values inside band by at least effective `cold-return-hysteresis`. Start bounds `[last in-band,first out-of-band]`, end bounds `[last out-of-band,first stable in-band]`; initially out of band means unknown earliest start. Open episode has `duration_bounds.high=null`. Low duration is max(0, earliest return - latest start), or window end - latest start for a continuously observed open episode; high is latest return - earliest start only when both known. `degree_minute_bounds` is the sum of adjacent observed rectangles over intervals <=10 minutes using min/max exceedance; no gap area. `peak_observed` is max observed sample. Exposure Finding requires 15-minute low duration, >=0.8 coverage and source gate; otherwise POSSIBLE/UNKNOWN. No spoilage, part-failure or continuous curve claim. Normal -> `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED`. Excursion -> first high at 19:15, open, duration low 45 min, high null. Backup-failed -> same exposure, door CONTEXT. Missing-probe -> 7/13, temperature UNKNOWN and no exposure Finding. Late-reading -> 12/13 at 20:05 and 13/13 at 20:10 with new basis/revision, old history retained.
+
+Start chain groups by `(correlation_id,generator_asset_id,outage episode)` and accepted event IDs. Required steps: POWER_LOSS, START_REQUEST, START_RESULT, generator state, TRANSFER_RESULT if sensor bound, bus state, compressor state, probe response. Within 30-second attested source-clock ordering tolerance, request 19:05 -> success 19:07 -> transfer 19:08 for normal. Explicit failed result 19:05 after 19:00 request supports `OBSERVED_FAILURE` only with no conflicting GOOD success. Timeout from Foundation = 5 min; inferred failure from timeout additionally requires complete generator state coverage through timeout. Missing transfer is `UNKNOWN_STEP` for transfer only; bus state cannot replace it. Contradictory GOOD success and failure for same correlation -> `CONTRADICTORY`, never failure. Equal event-ID conflict is a rejected S2 ordinal, not an accepted contradictory outcome. Excluded clock skew/SUSPECT/unbound records never support claims. Claim levels are `OBSERVED|BOUNDED|POSSIBLE|UNKNOWN|CONTRADICTORY`.
+
+Episode key is SHA-256 canonical JSON array `[tenant_id,site_id,kind,subject_asset_id,first_qualifying_event_or_crossing_evidence_id]` (UUIDs lowercase text), stored as `episode_key_sha256`. Stable anchor survives late evidence changing bounds. A newly supported different anchor after old invalidation creates a new episode and `split_from_episode_id`; old episode gets an immutable `NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED` revision and FindingRevision. Other transitions are `SUPPORT_CHANGED` when linked evidence changes and `BASIS_REFRESHED` when only effective configuration/source gate/known cutoff changes. Excursion and start response have separate Findings, can share public events, and later use one overlap group. Reuse `postgres_finding_store.py:_insert_finding,_insert_revision` with domain `cold_chain`; avoid dispatch-specific candidate-minute fields.
+
+## Migration `0022_w2_cold_assessment.py`
+
+After `0021`, create `cold_episode(id uuid PK,tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,site_id uuid NOT NULL,kind text CHECK IN ('EXCURSION','START_RESPONSE'),asset_id uuid NOT NULL,anchor_time timestamptz NOT NULL,episode_key_sha256 char(64) NOT NULL,split_from_episode_id uuid NULL,finding_id uuid NULL,created_at timestamptz NOT NULL)`. Unique `(tenant_id,site_id,episode_key_sha256)`; scoped composite FKs to Site, asset, optional split episode and Finding. Index `(site_id,kind,anchor_time)`. """The ScenarioDefinition persistence port, owned by the product domain.

Modelled on `assetops_backend/sites/ports.py`, and holding the same line for
the same reason. The port is the seam that makes storage replaceable, so its
signatures and its errors speak domain records only: no `Path`, no file handle,
no YAML text, no loader `dict`, and no store-specific exception may cross it.
An adapter that lets `yaml.YAMLError` or `OSError` escape has not implemented
the port, and a service layer that catches either has already lost the seam.

This is a parallel error family to the Site one, deliberately not a reuse of
it. A missing scenario and a missing Site are different facts about different
identity spaces, and a caller that caught `SiteNotFound` around a scenario
lookup would have confused the two. `ScenarioDefinitionRepository` is not a
subclass, mode, flag, or parameterization of `SiteRepository` and the two never
merge.

Read-only is structural here rather than a convention. T017 has no scenario
creation flow, so there is no `create_scenario` and no adapter has a write path
to implement. The writable user store exists as the other half of the identity
space and as the place later authoring will land; until that slice arrives,
nothing in the product can write a scenario.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Protocol, Sequence, runtime_checkable

from assetops_backend.scenarios.models import ScenarioDefinition


class ScenarioRepositoryError(Exception):
    """Base class for the scenario port's error vocabulary."""


class ScenarioNotFound(ScenarioRepositoryError):
    """No scenario with the requested `scenario_id` exists in either store."""


class ScenarioIdentityConflict(ScenarioRepositoryError):
    """A `scenario_id` resolves to two documents.

    Raised when the same identity is present twice within one store or once in
    each, including as a case variant. It fails loudly rather than resolving to
    one of them: there is no overlay and no precedence, because an identity
    that resolves to different content depending on store state cannot anchor
    the run history that later runs freeze a version against.
    """


class ScenarioConfigurationInvalid(ScenarioRepositoryError):
    """A scenario document is not valid configuration.

    Raised by the strict parser, by identity validation, and by adapters that
    meet undecodable or unparseable stored content. The message names what is
    wrong and what would be acceptable, because a user-authored scenario
    document will meet this text and a shipped-definition defect has to be
    diagnosable without reading the store.
    """


class ScenarioStoreUnavailable(ScenarioRepositoryError):
    """A scenario store could not be read.

    Distinct from `ScenarioConfigurationInvalid`: the content was never
    reached, so nothing is known about whether it is valid. A catalog must be
    able to say "the store could not be read" rather than "no scenario ships".
    """


@runtime_checkable
class ScenarioDefinitionRepository(Protocol):
    """Read access to saved ScenarioDefinitions, across both stores.

    Two methods, and no more. There is no create, update, delete, duplicate,
    publish, or approve, because T017 ships none of those capabilities and a
    port method for one would be a contract with nothing behind it. There is no
    query DSL, no pagination, and no caching method for the same reason.
    """

    def list_scenarios(self) -> Sequence[ScenarioDefinition]:
        """Return every saved scenario from every store.

        Raises:
            ScenarioIdentityConflict: one `scenario_id` resolves twice.
            ScenarioConfigurationInvalid: a stored document is invalid.
            ScenarioStoreUnavailable: a store could not be read.
        """
        ...

    def get_scenario(self, scenario_id: str) -> ScenarioDefinition:
        """Return one scenario by identity, compared without regard to case.

        Raises:
            ScenarioNotFound: no such `scenario_id`.
            ScenarioIdentityConflict: one `scenario_id` resolves twice.
            ScenarioConfigurationInvalid: `scenario_id` is malformed, or a
                stored document is invalid.
            ScenarioStoreUnavailable: a store could not be read.
        """
        ...

Generator start delay `2 min` and transfer delay `1 min` are versioned `cold-thermal/1` pack constants; they are not invented Foundation properties. Copy `source=SITE,source_version=1` on each property. Require exact effective values for this six-case fixture; the pack reads whatever valid thirteen values another registered Site freezes, with no silent fallback to fixture numbers. The pack's named defaults are used only when constructing a new scenario fixture, not to override Foundation. Existing COLD-001/002 bytes and W2-01 assertions stay intact.

Refuse an absent or mismatched tuple before publication; exclude the optional manual channel when undeclared. `binding_alignment.binding_content` already serializes all five optional keys; `postgres_foundation_store` persists the row JSON. Import the fixture and first conversion as historical v3-compatible revision, then call `BindingService.publish` at `2026-10-01T00:01:00Z` with the same eleven requests to create the immutable v4 revision; set scenario/run start after that instant. Do not mutate an existing revision or change existing W2-01 snapshot hashes. Verify the gateway's activated snapshot and S2 `ledger._decide_v4` see the same five keys. Include an explicit binding-publication helper in the walkthrough so a fresh private DB reproduces the revision.

+# W2-03 code-anchored build spec
+
+Decision `D-2026-10-17-w2-02-buildspec`. Implements `tasks/W2-03-cold-assessment.md` on the registered W2-02 replay. Use only accepted v4 public evidence, effective configuration and clock/source attestation. The six W2-02 manifest cases are the required phase-1 input; do not hand-insert accepted rows.

+## Inputs, model and selection
+
+Add `backend/assetops_backend/analytics/cold.py` with frozen `ColdEvidence` (`evidence_id`, `envelope_sha256`, `family`, `record_kind`, `role`, `asset_id`, `source_time`, `received_at`, `decided_at`, `quality`, `value`, `unit`, `event_id`, `correlation_id`, `outcome`, `source_id`, `clock_attested`), `ColdWindow` (`from_at`,`to_at`,`known_at`), `ColdExcursion`, `ColdStartChain` and `ColdAssessment`. Add pure `assess_excursion` and `assess_start_response`; IDs `cold-excursion/1`, `cold-start-response/1`. `backend/assetops_backend/analytics/adapters/postgres_assessment_store.py:query_evidence,_configuration,_persist,enqueue` is the pattern: select `accepted_evidence` joined to `ingestion_batch`, time-effective `foundation_revision` and `binding_set_revision` via `basis_from_snapshot`, and S4-05 `batch_publication_link/evidence_publication` for provenance. Require `site_id`, `source_time >= from`, `< to`, `received_at <= known_at`, and ingestion `decided_at <= known_at`. Order `(source_time,received_at,id)`. Only exact `cold-roles-1` effective row/asset/role, GOOD, calibrated primary chamber probe and attested clock is qualifying; SUSPECT, unbound, clock-skewed and contradictory records remain linked as CONTEXT/EXCLUDED with reason. Do not choose a latest publication by display name. Select the effective Foundation and binding at each evidence source time, and refuse if multiple periods overlap. `known_at` defaults to latest committed disposition watermark at request start; never a simulated clock. Basis SHA is SHA-256 of canonical JSON with keys `analytic_id,model_version,tenant_id,site_id,window,known_at,foundation_revision_ids,binding_revision_ids,source_gate,records`; records sorted by `(evidence_id,envelope_sha256)` and include both fields. `source_gate` is the exact S4-05 classification plus source IDs, not a boolean.

+`assessment_worker.py:DispatchAssessmentWorker` is the orchestration pattern. Add `ColdAssessmentWorker` with `assess_explicit` and `run_once`, using `recompute_job.domain='cold_chain'`. `postgres_assessment_store.py` alone inserts `analytic_run`, `analytic_run_evidence`, `assessment_revision`, `cold_episode`, `cold_episode_revision`, `cold_episode_evidence`; `postgres_finding_store.py` alone inserts/reads `finding` and `finding_revision`. Refactor both adapters to accept one caller-owned SQLAlchemy `Connection`; worker starts one transaction, persists assessment, episode, Finding and completes the job in it. No partial projection on failure. Existing dispatch methods keep their old transactions and bytes. Duplicate basis returns the existing revision; changed basis appends a revision. Relevant cold `accepted_evidence` after intake enqueues a bracketed cold job; duplicate or rejected ordinal does not. A queued/failed newer job makes previous selected read `PENDING_RECOMPUTE` until the shared transaction commits.

+## Rules and exact outcomes
+
+Expected points are the 13 five-minute instants 19:00 through 20:00 in `[19:00,20:05)`; coverage numerator is distinct qualifying probe timestamps, denominator 13 (general windows derive their own aligned count), capped at 1. Need `>=0.8`, with no inferred path across a >10-minute gap. Above upper or below lower policy needs two consecutive GOOD samples at least five minutes apart; return needs two consecutive values inside band by at least effective `cold-return-hysteresis`. Start bounds `[last in-band,first out-of-band]`, end bounds `[last out-of-band,first stable in-band]`; initially out of band means unknown earliest start. Open episode has `duration_bounds.high=null`. Low duration is max(0, earliest return - latest start), or window end - latest start for a continuously observed open episode; high is latest return - earliest start only when both known. `degree_minute_bounds` is the sum of adjacent observed rectangles over intervals <=10 minutes using min/max exceedance; no gap area. `peak_observed` is max observed sample. Exposure Finding requires 15-minute low duration, >=0.8 coverage and source gate; otherwise POSSIBLE/UNKNOWN. No spoilage, part-failure or continuous curve claim. Normal -> `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED`. Excursion -> first high at 19:15, open, duration low 45 min, high null. Backup-failed -> same exposure, door CONTEXT. Missing-probe -> 7/13, temperature UNKNOWN and no exposure Finding. Late-reading -> 12/13 at 20:05 and 13/13 at 20:10 with new basis/revision, old history retained.
+
+Start chain groups by `(correlation_id,generator_asset_id,outage episode)` and accepted event IDs. Required steps: POWER_LOSS, START_REQUEST, START_RESULT, generator state, TRANSFER_RESULT if sensor bound, bus state, compressor state, probe response. Within 30-second attested source-clock ordering tolerance, request 19:05 -> success 19:07 -> transfer 19:08 for normal. Explicit failed result 19:05 after 19:00 request supports `OBSERVED_FAILURE` only with no conflicting GOOD success. Timeout from Foundation = 5 min; inferred failure from timeout additionally requires complete generator state coverage through timeout. Missing transfer is `UNKNOWN_STEP` for transfer only; bus state cannot replace it. Contradictory GOOD success and failure for same correlation -> `CONTRADICTORY`, never failure. Equal event-ID conflict is a rejected S2 ordinal, not an accepted contradictory outcome. Excluded clock skew/SUSPECT/unbound records never support claims. Claim levels are `OBSERVED|BOUNDED|POSSIBLE|UNKNOWN|CONTRADICTORY`.
+
+Episode key is SHA-256 canonical JSON array `[tenant_id,site_id,kind,subject_asset_id,first_qualifying_event_or_crossing_evidence_id]` (UUIDs lowercase text), stored as `episode_key_sha256`. Stable anchor survives late evidence changing bounds. A newly supported different anchor after old invalidation creates a new episode and `split_from_episode_id`; old episode gets an immutable `NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED` revision and FindingRevision. Other transitions are `SUPPORT_CHANGED` when linked evidence changes and `BASIS_REFRESHED` when only effective configuration/source gate/known cutoff changes. Excursion and start response have separate Findings, can share public events, and later use one overlap group. Reuse `postgres_finding_store.py:_insert_finding,_insert_revision` with domain `cold_chain`; avoid dispatch-specific candidate-minute fields.
+

+# W2-03 code-anchored build spec
+
+Decision `D-2026-10-17-w2-02-buildspec`. Implements `tasks/W2-03-cold-assessment.md` on the registered W2-02 replay. Use only accepted v4 public evidence, effective configuration and clock/source attestation. The six W2-02 manifest cases are the required phase-1 input; do not hand-insert accepted rows.

+## Inputs, model and selection
+
+Add `backend/assetops_backend/analytics/cold.py` with frozen `ColdEvidence` (`evidence_id`, `envelope_sha256`, `family`, `record_kind`, `role`, `asset_id`, `source_time`, `received_at`, `decided_at`, `quality`, `value`, `unit`, `event_id`, `correlation_id`, `outcome`, `source_id`, `clock_attested`), `ColdWindow` (`from_at`,`to_at`,`known_at`), `ColdExcursion`, `ColdStartChain` and `ColdAssessment`. Add pure `assess_excursion` and `assess_start_response`; IDs `cold-excursion/1`, `cold-start-response/1`. `backend/assetops_backend/analytics/adapters/postgres_assessment_store.py:query_evidence,_configuration,_persist,enqueue` is the pattern: select `accepted_evidence` joined to `ingestion_batch`, time-effective `foundation_revision` and `binding_set_revision` via `basis_from_snapshot`, and S4-05 `batch_publication_link/evidence_publication` for provenance. Require `site_id`, `source_time >= from`, `< to`, `received_at <= known_at`, and ingestion `decided_at <= known_at`. Order `(source_time,received_at,id)`. Only exact `cold-roles-1` effective row/asset/role, GOOD, calibrated primary chamber probe and attested clock is qualifying; SUSPECT, unbound, clock-skewed and contradictory records remain linked as CONTEXT/EXCLUDED with reason. Do not choose a latest publication by display name. Select the effective Foundation and binding at each evidence source time, and refuse if multiple periods overlap. `known_at` defaults to latest committed disposition watermark at request start; never a simulated clock. Basis SHA is SHA-256 of canonical JSON with keys `analytic_id,model_version,tenant_id,site_id,window,known_at,foundation_revision_ids,binding_revision_ids,source_gate,records`; records sorted by `(evidence_id,envelope_sha256)` and include both fields. `source_gate` is the exact S4-05 classification plus source IDs, not a boolean.

+`assessment_worker.py:DispatchAssessmentWorker` is the orchestration pattern. Add `ColdAssessmentWorker` with `assess_explicit` and `run_once`, using `recompute_job.domain='cold_chain'`. `postgres_assessment_store.py` alone inserts `analytic_run`, `analytic_run_evidence`, `assessment_revision`, `cold_episode`, `cold_episode_revision`, `cold_episode_evidence`; `postgres_finding_store.py` alone inserts/reads `finding` and `finding_revision`. Refactor both adapters to accept one caller-owned SQLAlchemy `Connection`; worker starts one transaction, persists assessment, episode, Finding and completes the job in it. No partial projection on failure. Existing dispatch methods keep their old transactions and bytes. Duplicate basis returns the existing revision; changed basis appends a revision. Relevant cold `accepted_evidence` after intake enqueues a bracketed cold job; duplicate or rejected ordinal does not. A queued/failed newer job makes previous selected read `PENDING_RECOMPUTE` until the shared transaction commits.
+
+## Rules and exact outcomes
+
+Expected points are the 13 five-minute instants 19:00 through 20:00 in `[19:00,20:05)`; coverage numerator is distinct qualifying probe timestamps, denominator 13 (general windows derive their own aligned count), capped at 1. Need `>=0.8`, with no inferred path across a >10-minute gap. Above upper or below lower policy needs two consecutive GOOD samples at least five minutes apart; return needs two consecutive values inside band by at least effective `cold-return-hysteresis`. Start bounds `[last in-band,first out-of-band]`, end bounds `[last out-of-band,first stable in-band]`; initially out of band means unknown earliest start. Open episode has `duration_bounds.high=null`. Low duration is max(0, earliest return - latest start), or window end - latest start for a continuously observed open episode; high is latest return - earliest start only when both known. `degree_minute_bounds` is the sum of adjacent observed rectangles over intervals <=10 minutes using min/max exceedance; no gap area. `peak_observed` is max observed sample. Exposure Finding requires 15-minute low duration, >=0.8 coverage and source gate; otherwise POSSIBLE/UNKNOWN. No spoilage, part-failure or continuous curve claim. Normal -> `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED`. Excursion -> first high at 19:15, open, duration low 45 min, high null. Backup-failed -> same exposure, door CONTEXT. Missing-probe -> 7/13, temperature UNKNOWN and no exposure Finding. Late-reading -> 12/13 at 20:05 and 13/13 at 20:10 with new basis/revision, old history retained.
+
+Start chain groups by `(correlation_id,generator_asset_id,outage episode)` and accepted event IDs. Required steps: POWER_LOSS, START_REQUEST, START_RESULT, generator state, TRANSFER_RESULT if sensor bound, bus state, compressor state, probe response. Within 30-second attested source-clock ordering tolerance, request 19:05 -> success 19:07 -> transfer 19:08 for normal. Explicit failed result 19:05 after 19:00 request supports `OBSERVED_FAILURE` only with no conflicting GOOD success. Timeout from Foundation = 5 min; inferred failure from timeout additionally requires complete generator state coverage through timeout. Missing transfer is `UNKNOWN_STEP` for transfer only; bus state cannot replace it. Contradictory GOOD success and failure for same correlation -> `CONTRADICTORY`, never failure. Equal event-ID conflict is a rejected S2 ordinal, not an accepted contradictory outcome. Excluded clock skew/SUSPECT/unbound records never support claims. Claim levels are `OBSERVED|BOUNDED|POSSIBLE|UNKNOWN|CONTRADICTORY`.
+
+Episode key is SHA-256 canonical JSON array `[tenant_id,site_id,kind,subject_asset_id,first_qualifying_event_or_crossing_evidence_id]` (UUIDs lowercase text), stored as `episode_key_sha256`. Stable anchor survives late evidence changing bounds. A newly supported different anchor after old invalidation creates a new episode and `split_from_episode_id`; old episode gets an immutable `NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED` revision and FindingRevision. Other transitions are `SUPPORT_CHANGED` when linked evidence changes and `BASIS_REFRESHED` when only effective configuration/source gate/known cutoff changes. Excursion and start response have separate Findings, can share public events, and later use one overlap group. Reuse `postgres_finding_store.py:_insert_finding,_insert_revision` with domain `cold_chain`; avoid dispatch-specific candidate-minute fields.
+

+# W2-03 code-anchored build spec
+
+Decision `D-2026-10-17-w2-02-buildspec`. Implements `tasks/W2-03-cold-assessment.md` on the registered W2-02 replay. +## Inputs, model and selection
+
+Add `backend/assetops_backend/analytics/cold.py` with frozen `ColdEvidence` (`evidence_id`, `envelope_sha256`, `family`, `record_kind`, `role`, `asset_id`, `source_time`, `received_at`, `decided_at`, `quality`, `value`, `unit`, `event_id`, `correlation_id`, `outcome`, `source_id`, `clock_attested`), `ColdWindow` (`from_at`,`to_at`,`known_at`), `ColdExcursion`, `ColdStartChain` and `ColdAssessment`. Require `site_id`, `source_time >= from`, `< to`, `received_at <= known_at`, and ingestion `decided_at <= known_at`. Order `(source_time,received_at,id)`. Only exact `cold-roles-1` effective row/asset/role, GOOD, calibrated primary chamber probe and attested clock is qualifying; SUSPECT, unbound, clock-skewed and contradictory records remain linked as CONTEXT/EXCLUDED with reason. Do not choose a latest publication by display name. Select the effective Foundation and binding at each evidence source time, and refuse if multiple periods overlap. `known_at` defaults to latest committed disposition watermark at request start; never a simulated clock. Basis SHA is SHA-256 of canonical JSON with keys `analytic_id,model_version,tenant_id,site_id,window,known_at,foundation_revision_ids,binding_revision_ids,source_gate,records`; records sorted by `(evidence_id,envelope_sha256)` and include both fields. `source_gate` is the exact S4-05 classification plus source IDs, not a boolean.

+`assessment_worker.py:DispatchAssessmentWorker` is the orchestration pattern. Refactor both adapters to accept one caller-owned SQLAlchemy `Connection`; worker starts one transaction, persists assessment, episode, Finding and completes the job in it. No partial projection on failure. Existing dispatch methods keep their old transactions and bytes. Duplicate basis returns the existing revision; changed basis appends a revision. Relevant cold `accepted_evidence` after intake enqueues a bracketed cold job; duplicate or rejected ordinal does not. A queued/failed newer job makes previous selected read `PENDING_RECOMPUTE` until the shared transaction commits.

+## Rules and exact outcomes
+
+Expected points are the 13 five-minute instants 19:00 through 20:00 in `[19:00,20:05)`; coverage numerator is distinct qualifying probe timestamps, denominator 13 (general windows derive their own aligned count), capped at 1. Need `>=0.8`, with no inferred path across a >10-minute gap. Above upper or below lower policy needs two consecutive GOOD samples at least five minutes apart; return needs two consecutive values inside band by at least effective `cold-return-hysteresis`. Start bounds `[last in-band,first out-of-band]`, end bounds `[last out-of-band,first stable in-band]`; initially out of band means unknown earliest start. Open episode has `duration_bounds.high=null`. Low duration is max(0, earliest return - latest start), or window end - latest start for a continuously observed open episode; high is latest return - earliest start only when both known. `degree_minute_bounds` is the sum of adjacent observed rectangles over intervals <=10 minutes using min/max exceedance; no gap area. `peak_observed` is max observed sample. Exposure Finding requires 15-minute low duration, >=0.8 coverage and source gate; otherwise POSSIBLE/UNKNOWN. No spoilage, part-failure or continuous curve claim. Normal -> `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED`. Excursion -> first high at 19:15, open, duration low 45 min, high null. Backup-failed -> same exposure, door CONTEXT. Missing-probe -> 7/13, temperature UNKNOWN and no exposure Finding. Late-reading -> 12/13 at 20:05 and 13/13 at 20:10 with new basis/revision, old history retained.
+
+Start chain groups by `(correlation_id,generator_asset_id,outage episode)` and accepted event IDs. Required steps: POWER_LOSS, START_REQUEST, START_RESULT, generator state, TRANSFER_RESULT if sensor bound, bus state, compressor state, probe response. Within 30-second attested source-clock ordering tolerance, request 19:05 -> success 19:07 -> transfer 19:08 for normal. Explicit failed result 19:05 after 19:00 request supports `OBSERVED_FAILURE` only with no conflicting GOOD success. Timeout from Foundation = 5 min; inferred failure from timeout additionally requires complete generator state coverage through timeout. Missing transfer is `UNKNOWN_STEP` for transfer only; bus state cannot replace it. Contradictory GOOD success and failure for same correlation -> `CONTRADICTORY`, never failure. Equal event-ID conflict is a rejected S2 ordinal, not an accepted contradictory outcome. Excluded clock skew/SUSPECT/unbound records never support claims. Claim levels are `OBSERVED|BOUNDED|POSSIBLE|UNKNOWN|CONTRADICTORY`.
+
+Episode key is SHA-256 canonical JSON array `[tenant_id,site_id,kind,subject_asset_id,first_qualifying_event_or_crossing_evidence_id]` (UUIDs lowercase text), stored as `episode_key_sha256`. Stable anchor survives late evidence changing bounds. A newly supported different anchor after old invalidation creates a new episode and `split_from_episode_id`; old episode gets an immutable `NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED` revision and FindingRevision. Other transitions are `SUPPORT_CHANGED` when linked evidence changes and `BASIS_REFRESHED` when only effective configuration/source gate/known cutoff changes. Excursion and start response have separate Findings, can share public events, and later use one overlap group. Reuse `postgres_finding_store.py:_insert_finding,_insert_revision` with domain `cold_chain`; avoid dispatch-specific candidate-minute fields.
+

+## Rules and exact outcomes
+
+Expected points are the 13 five-minute instants 19:00 through 20:00 in `[19:00,20:05)`; coverage numerator is distinct qualifying probe timestamps, denominator 13 (general windows derive their own aligned count), capped at 1. Need `>=0.8`, with no inferred path across a >10-minute gap. Above upper or below lower policy needs two consecutive GOOD samples at least five minutes apart; return needs two consecutive values inside band by at least effective `cold-return-hysteresis`. Start bounds `[last in-band,first out-of-band]`, end bounds `[last out-of-band,first stable in-band]`; initially out of band means unknown earliest start. Open episode has `duration_bounds.high=null`. Low duration is max(0, earliest return - latest start), or window end - latest start for a continuously observed open episode; high is latest return - earliest start only when both known. `degree_minute_bounds` is the sum of adjacent observed rectangles over intervals <=10 minutes using min/max exceedance; no gap area. `peak_observed` is max observed sample. Exposure Finding requires 15-minute low duration, >=0.8 coverage and source gate; otherwise POSSIBLE/UNKNOWN. No spoilage, part-failure or continuous curve claim. Normal -> `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED`. Excursion -> first high at 19:15, open, duration low 45 min, high null. Backup-failed -> same exposure, door CONTEXT. Missing-probe -> 7/13, temperature UNKNOWN and no exposure Finding. Late-reading -> 12/13 at 20:05 and 13/13 at 20:10 with new basis/revision, old history retained.
+
+Start chain groups by `(correlation_id,generator_asset_id,outage episode)` and accepted event IDs. Required steps: POWER_LOSS, START_REQUEST, START_RESULT, generator state, TRANSFER_RESULT if sensor bound, bus state, compressor state, probe response. Within 30-second attested source-clock ordering tolerance, request 19:05 -> success 19:07 -> transfer 19:08 for normal. Explicit failed result 19:05 after 19:00 request supports `OBSERVED_FAILURE` only with no conflicting GOOD success. Timeout from Foundation = 5 min; inferred failure from timeout additionally requires complete generator state coverage through timeout. Missing transfer is `UNKNOWN_STEP` for transfer only; bus state cannot replace it. Contradictory GOOD success and failure for same correlation -> `CONTRADICTORY`, never failure. Equal event-ID conflict is a rejected S2 ordinal, not an accepted contradictory outcome. Excluded clock skew/SUSPECT/unbound records never support claims. Claim levels are `OBSERVED|BOUNDED|POSSIBLE|UNKNOWN|CONTRADICTORY`.
+
+Episode key is SHA-256 canonical JSON array `[tenant_id,site_id,kind,subject_asset_id,first_qualifying_event_or_crossing_evidence_id]` (UUIDs lowercase text), stored as `episode_key_sha256`. Stable anchor survives late evidence changing bounds. A newly supported different anchor after old invalidation creates a new episode and `split_from_episode_id`; old episode gets an immutable `NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED` revision and FindingRevision. Other transitions are `SUPPORT_CHANGED` when linked evidence changes and `BASIS_REFRESHED` when only effective configuration/source gate/known cutoff changes. Excursion and start response have separate Findings, can share public events, and later use one overlap group. Reuse `postgres_finding_store.py:_insert_finding,_insert_revision` with domain `cold_chain`; avoid dispatch-specific candidate-minute fields.

Add `ColdAssessmentWorker` with `assess_explicit` and `run_once`, using `recompute_job.domain='cold_chain'`. `postgres_assessment_store.py` alone inserts `analytic_run`, `analytic_run_evidence`, `assessment_revision`, `cold_episode`, `cold_episode_revision`, `cold_episode_evidence`; `postgres_finding_store.py` alone inserts/reads `finding` and `finding_revision`. Refactor both adapters to accept one caller-owned SQLAlchemy `Connection`; worker starts one transaction, persists assessment, episode, Finding and completes the job in it. No partial projection on failure. Existing dispatch methods keep their old transactions and bytes. Duplicate basis returns the existing revision; changed basis appends a revision. Relevant cold `accepted_evidence` after intake enqueues a bracketed cold job; duplicate or rejected ordinal does not. A queued/failed newer job makes previous selected read `PENDING_RECOMPUTE` until the shared transaction commits.
+
+## Rules and exact outcomes
+
+Expected points are the 13 five-minute instants 19:00 through 20:00 in `[19:00,20:05)`; coverage numerator is distinct qualifying probe timestamps, denominator 13 (general windows derive their own aligned count), capped at 1. Need `>=0.8`, with no inferred path across a >10-minute gap. Above upper or below lower policy needs two consecutive GOOD samples at least five minutes apart; return needs two consecutive values inside band by at least effective `cold-return-hysteresis`. Start bounds `[last in-band,first out-of-band]`, end bounds `[last out-of-band,first stable in-band]`; initially out of band means unknown earliest start. Open episode has `duration_bounds.high=null`. Low duration is max(0, earliest return - latest start), or window end - latest start for a continuously observed open episode; high is latest return - earliest start only when both known. `degree_minute_bounds` is the sum of adjacent observed rectangles over intervals <=10 minutes using min/max exceedance; no gap area. `peak_observed` is max observed sample. Exposure Finding requires 15-minute low duration, >=0.8 coverage and source gate; otherwise POSSIBLE/UNKNOWN. No spoilage, part-failure or continuous curve claim. Normal -> `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED`. Excursion -> first high at 19:15, open, duration low 45 min, high null. Backup-failed -> same exposure, door CONTEXT. Missing-probe -> 7/13, temperature UNKNOWN and no exposure Finding. Late-reading -> 12/13 at 20:05 and 13/13 at 20:10 with new basis/revision, old history retained.
+
+Start chain groups by `(correlation_id,generator_asset_id,outage episode)` and accepted event IDs. Required steps: POWER_LOSS, START_REQUEST, START_RESULT, generator state, TRANSFER_RESULT if sensor bound, bus state, compressor state, probe response. Within 30-second attested source-clock ordering tolerance, request 19:05 -> success 19:07 -> transfer 19:08 for normal. Explicit failed result 19:05 after 19:00 request supports `OBSERVED_FAILURE` only with no conflicting GOOD success. Timeout from Foundation = 5 min; inferred failure from timeout additionally requires complete generator state coverage through timeout. Missing transfer is `UNKNOWN_STEP` for transfer only; bus state cannot replace it. Contradictory GOOD success and failure for same correlation -> `CONTRADICTORY`, never failure. Equal event-ID conflict is a rejected S2 ordinal, not an accepted contradictory outcome. Excluded clock skew/SUSPECT/unbound records never support claims. Claim levels are `OBSERVED|BOUNDED|POSSIBLE|UNKNOWN|CONTRADICTORY`.
+
+Episode key is SHA-256 canonical JSON array `[tenant_id,site_id,kind,subject_asset_id,first_qualifying_event_or_crossing_evidence_id]` (UUIDs lowercase text), stored as `episode_key_sha256`. Stable anchor survives late evidence changing bounds. A newly supported different anchor after old invalidation creates a new episode and `split_from_episode_id`; old episode gets an immutable `NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED` revision and FindingRevision. Other transitions are `SUPPORT_CHANGED` when linked evidence changes and `BASIS_REFRESHED` when only effective configuration/source gate/known cutoff changes. Excursion and start response have separate Findings, can share public events, and later use one overlap group. Reuse `postgres_finding_store.py:_insert_finding,_insert_revision` with domain `cold_chain`; avoid dispatch-specific candidate-minute fields.
+

+# W2-03 code-anchored build spec
+
+Decision `D-2026-10-17-w2-02-buildspec`. Implements `tasks/W2-03-cold-assessment.md` on the registered W2-02 replay. Use only accepted v4 public evidence, effective configuration and clock/source attestation. The six W2-02 manifest cases are the required phase-1 input; do not hand-insert accepted rows.

+## Inputs, model and selection
+
+Add `backend/assetops_backend/analytics/cold.py` with frozen `ColdEvidence` (`evidence_id`, `envelope_sha256`, `family`, `record_kind`, `role`, `asset_id`, `source_time`, `received_at`, `decided_at`, `quality`, `value`, `unit`, `event_id`, `correlation_id`, `outcome`, `source_id`, `clock_attested`), `ColdWindow` (`from_at`,`to_at`,`known_at`), `ColdExcursion`, `ColdStartChain` and `ColdAssessment`. Add pure `assess_excursion` and `assess_start_response`; IDs `cold-excursion/1`, `cold-start-response/1`. `backend/assetops_backend/analytics/adapters/postgres_assessment_store.py:query_evidence,_configuration,_persist,enqueue` is the pattern: select `accepted_evidence` joined to `ingestion_batch`, time-effective `foundation_revision` and `binding_set_revision` via `basis_from_snapshot`, and S4-05 `batch_publication_link/evidence_publication` for provenance. Require `site_id`, `source_time >= from`, `< to`, `received_at <= known_at`, and ingestion `decided_at <= known_at`. Order `(source_time,received_at,id)`. Only exact `cold-roles-1` effective row/asset/role, GOOD, calibrated primary chamber probe and attested clock is qualifying; SUSPECT, unbound, clock-skewed and contradictory records remain linked as CONTEXT/EXCLUDED with reason. Do not choose a latest publication by display name. Select the effective Foundation and binding at each evidence source time, and refuse if multiple periods overlap. `known_at` defaults to latest committed disposition watermark at request start; never a simulated clock. Basis SHA is SHA-256 of canonical JSON with keys `analytic_id,model_version,tenant_id,site_id,window,known_at,foundation_revision_ids,binding_revision_ids,source_gate,records`; records sorted by `(evidence_id,envelope_sha256)` and include both fields. `source_gate` is the exact S4-05 classification plus source IDs, not a boolean.

Add `ColdAssessmentWorker` with `assess_explicit` and `run_once`, using `recompute_job.domain='cold_chain'`. `postgres_assessment_store.py` alone inserts `analytic_run`, `analytic_run_evidence`, `assessment_revision`, `cold_episode`, `cold_episode_revision`, `cold_episode_evidence`; `postgres_finding_store.py` alone inserts/reads `finding` and `finding_revision`. Refactor both adapters to accept one caller-owned SQLAlchemy `Connection`; worker starts one transaction, persists assessment, episode, Finding and completes the job in it. No partial projection on failure. Existing dispatch methods keep their old transactions and bytes. Duplicate basis returns the existing revision; changed basis appends a revision. Relevant cold `accepted_evidence` after intake enqueues a bracketed cold job; duplicate or rejected ordinal does not. A queued/failed newer job makes previous selected read `PENDING_RECOMPUTE` until the shared transaction commits.

+## Rules and exact outcomes
+
+Expected points are the 13 five-minute instants 19:00 through 20:00 in `[19:00,20:05)`; coverage numerator is distinct qualifying probe timestamps, denominator 13 (general windows derive their own aligned count), capped at 1. Need `>=0.8`, with no inferred path across a >10-minute gap. Above upper or below lower policy needs two consecutive GOOD samples at least five minutes apart; return needs two consecutive values inside band by at least effective `cold-return-hysteresis`. Start bounds `[last in-band,first out-of-band]`, end bounds `[last out-of-band,first stable in-band]`; initially out of band means unknown earliest start. Open episode has `duration_bounds.high=null`. Low duration is max(0, earliest return - latest start), or window end - latest start for a continuously observed open episode; high is latest return - earliest start only when both known. `degree_minute_bounds` is the sum of adjacent observed rectangles over intervals <=10 minutes using min/max exceedance; no gap area. `peak_observed` is max observed sample. Exposure Finding requires 15-minute low duration, >=0.8 coverage and source gate; otherwise POSSIBLE/UNKNOWN. No spoilage, part-failure or continuous curve claim. Normal -> `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED`. Excursion -> first high at 19:15, open, duration low 45 min, high null. Backup-failed -> same exposure, door CONTEXT. Missing-probe -> 7/13, temperature UNKNOWN and no exposure Finding. Late-reading -> 12/13 at 20:05 and 13/13 at 20:10 with new basis/revision, old history retained.
+
+Start chain groups by `(correlation_id,generator_asset_id,outage episode)` and accepted event IDs. Required steps: POWER_LOSS, START_REQUEST, START_RESULT, generator state, TRANSFER_RESULT if sensor bound, bus state, compressor state, probe response. Within 30-second attested source-clock ordering tolerance, request 19:05 -> success 19:07 -> transfer 19:08 for normal. Explicit failed result 19:05 after 19:00 request supports `OBSERVED_FAILURE` only with no conflicting GOOD success. Timeout from Foundation = 5 min; inferred failure from timeout additionally requires complete generator state coverage through timeout. Missing transfer is `UNKNOWN_STEP` for transfer only; bus state cannot replace it. Contradictory GOOD success and failure for same correlation -> `CONTRADICTORY`, never failure. Equal event-ID conflict is a rejected S2 ordinal, not an accepted contradictory outcome. Excluded clock skew/SUSPECT/unbound records never support claims. Claim levels are `OBSERVED|BOUNDED|POSSIBLE|UNKNOWN|CONTRADICTORY`.
+
+Episode key is SHA-256 canonical JSON array `[tenant_id,site_id,kind,subject_asset_id,first_qualifying_event_or_crossing_evidence_id]` (UUIDs lowercase text), stored as `episode_key_sha256`. Stable anchor survives late evidence changing bounds. A newly supported different anchor after old invalidation creates a new episode and `split_from_episode_id`; old episode gets an immutable `NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED` revision and FindingRevision. Other transitions are `SUPPORT_CHANGED` when linked evidence changes and `BASIS_REFRESHED` when only effective configuration/source gate/known cutoff changes. Excursion and start response have separate Findings, can share public events, and later use one overlap group. Reuse `postgres_finding_store.py:_insert_finding,_insert_revision` with domain `cold_chain`; avoid dispatch-specific candidate-minute fields.
+

+## Rules and exact outcomes
+
+Expected points are the 13 five-minute instants 19:00 through 20:00 in `[19:00,20:05)`; coverage numerator is distinct qualifying probe timestamps, denominator 13 (general windows derive their own aligned count), capped at 1. Need `>=0.8`, with no inferred path across a >10-minute gap. Above upper or below lower policy needs two consecutive GOOD samples at least five minutes apart; return needs two consecutive values inside band by at least effective `cold-return-hysteresis`. Start bounds `[last in-band,first out-of-band]`, end bounds `[last out-of-band,first stable in-band]`; initially out of band means unknown earliest start. Open episode has `duration_bounds.high=null`. Low duration is max(0, earliest return - latest start), or window end - latest start for a continuously observed open episode; high is latest return - earliest start only when both known. `degree_minute_bounds` is the sum of adjacent observed rectangles over intervals <=10 minutes using min/max exceedance; no gap area. `peak_observed` is max observed sample. Exposure Finding requires 15-minute low duration, >=0.8 coverage and source gate; otherwise POSSIBLE/UNKNOWN. No spoilage, part-failure or continuous curve claim. Normal -> `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED`. Excursion -> first high at 19:15, open, duration low 45 min, high null. Backup-failed -> same exposure, door CONTEXT. Missing-probe -> 7/13, temperature UNKNOWN and no exposure Finding. Late-reading -> 12/13 at 20:05 and 13/13 at 20:10 with new basis/revision, old history retained.
+
+Start chain groups by `(correlation_id,generator_asset_id,outage episode)` and accepted event IDs. Required steps: POWER_LOSS, START_REQUEST, START_RESULT, generator state, TRANSFER_RESULT if sensor bound, bus state, compressor state, probe response. Within 30-second attested source-clock ordering tolerance, request 19:05 -> success 19:07 -> transfer 19:08 for normal. Explicit failed result 19:05 after 19:00 request supports `OBSERVED_FAILURE` only with no conflicting GOOD success. Timeout from Foundation = 5 min; inferred failure from timeout additionally requires complete generator state coverage through timeout. Missing transfer is `UNKNOWN_STEP` for transfer only; bus state cannot replace it. Contradictory GOOD success and failure for same correlation -> `CONTRADICTORY`, never failure. Equal event-ID conflict is a rejected S2 ordinal, not an accepted contradictory outcome. Excluded clock skew/SUSPECT/unbound records never support claims. Claim levels are `OBSERVED|BOUNDED|POSSIBLE|UNKNOWN|CONTRADICTORY`.
+
+Episode key is SHA-256 canonical JSON array `[tenant_id,site_id,kind,subject_asset_id,first_qualifying_event_or_crossing_evidence_id]` (UUIDs lowercase text), stored as `episode_key_sha256`. Stable anchor survives late evidence changing bounds. A newly supported different anchor after old invalidation creates a new episode and `split_from_episode_id`; old episode gets an immutable `NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED` revision and FindingRevision. Other transitions are `SUPPORT_CHANGED` when linked evidence changes and `BASIS_REFRESHED` when only effective configuration/source gate/known cutoff changes. Excursion and start response have separate Findings, can share public events, and later use one overlap group. Reuse `postgres_finding_store.py:_insert_finding,_insert_revision` with domain `cold_chain`; avoid dispatch-specific candidate-minute fields.

+# W2-03 code-anchored build spec
+
+Decision `D-2026-10-17-w2-02-buildspec`. Implements `tasks/W2-03-cold-assessment.md` on the registered W2-02 replay. Use only accepted v4 public evidence, effective configuration and clock/source attestation. The six W2-02 manifest cases are the required phase-1 input; do not hand-insert accepted rows.
